sourceRecords.title: Identification of a specific telomere terminal transferase activity in Tetrahymena extracts
sourceRecords.publisher: Carol Greider and Elizabeth Blackburn / Cell
sourceRecords.note: 1985 experimental paper; abstract and bibliographic record.

sourceRecords.title: The telomere terminal transferase of Tetrahymena is a ribonucleoprotein enzyme with two kinds of primer specificity
sourceRecords.note: 1987 RNA and protein requirements; abstract and record.

sourceRecords.title: A telomeric sequence in the RNA of Tetrahymena telomerase required for telomere repeat synthesis
sourceRecords.note: 1989 RNA-template evidence; distinguish subsequent functional template experiments by other authors.

sourceRecords.title: Telomeres shorten during ageing of human fibroblasts
sourceRecords.note: 1990 cell-culture study, not a human longevity intervention. Publisher access is intermittent.

sourceRecords.title: Telomere shortening and tumor formation by mouse cells lacking telomerase RNA
sourceRecords.note: 1997 mouse study; six generations analyzed, not human efficacy.

sourceRecords.title: Telomerase mutations in families with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis
sourceRecords.publisher: Armanios and colleagues / New England Journal of Medicine
sourceRecords.note: 2007 study: mutations in six of 73 probands. Defined familial population, not all pulmonary fibrosis.

sourceRecords.title: Diagnostic utility of telomere length testing in a hospital-based setting
sourceRecords.note: 2018 targeted observational study; decisions changed in nine of 38 cases, not a randomized survival benefit. Authorship contributions checked.

sourceRecords.title: Human telomere length is chromosome end-specific and conserved across individuals
sourceRecords.note: 2024 peer-reviewed study; distinguished from the older preprint and a newer 2026 protocol.

sourceRecords.title: New study reveals unexpected complexity in human telomere lengths
sourceRecords.note: April 11, 2024 institutional research reporting: 147 people, end-specific measurements and sequencing collaborators.

sourceRecords.title: Nanopore sequencing to measure chromosome end-specific telomere lengths in human cells
sourceRecords.publisher: Groot, Karimian, Rechsteiner and Greider / bioRxiv
sourceRecords.note: August 2026: indexed page says August 18, repository API August 20. Exact posting-date discrepancy unresolved. Full text inaccessible during this reporting run; protocol description relies on repository abstract and metadata, not an independent methods audit.

sourceRecords.title: Repository metadata for the 2026 Telomere Profiling protocol
